sources.author: Jomo via Google Maps
observations: Six narrow dark upper windows, plain stone panel wall, tall blank parapet zone, lower height than Prezzo. Old shop signage not used as current identity.

sources.author: Niko S. via Google Maps
observations: Continuous flat roof behind parapet, shallow roof features, frontage between Prezzo and larger British Heart Foundation building.

sources.author: davidsong
observations: Neighbourhood and Prezzo registration only; this frame does not resolve the terrace facade.
Green polished piers, silver narrow mullions, two main panes and right door, blue bands and fascia lettering, projecting black sign.
Tall upper transom with pizzeria lettering, black awning below it, large ground pane and right recessed entry.

sources.author: Micropub Adventures
observations: Bugle Tap black fascia with pale lettering, narrow high transoms, dark glazed folding frontage and right door; Mamma Mia blue projecting sign adjoining; polished pier and ATM at right edge.
Listing calls terrace 118–122 Lord Street and gives year built 1966 (listing claim, not independently verified). Full property image could not be retrieved; not used as pixel evidence.
Whole block envelope and restaurant POIs, not independent surveyed unit boundaries.
